items.source: A wrapper or marker for a Neo4j org.neo4j.driver.internal.value.MapValue that needs to be unwrapped when used for properties. This class exists solely for projection / filtering purposes: It allows the DefaultNeo4jEntityConverter to keep the composite properties together as long as possible (in the form of above's MapValue. Thus, the key in the Constants.NAME_OF_PROPERTIES_PARAM fits the filter so that we can continue filtering after binding.
items.translation: 一个用于 Neo4j `org.neo4j.driver.internal.value.MapValue` 的包装器或标记，该值在使用属性时需要解包。此类仅用于投影/过滤目的：它允许 `DefaultNeo4jEntityConverter` 尽可能长时间地将复合属性保持在一起（以上述的 `MapValue` 形式）。因此，Constants.NAME_OF_PROPERTIES_PARAM 中的键能够匹配过滤器，以便在绑定后继续执行过滤操作。
